info.bio: Katheryn Elizabeth Hudson (Santa Bárbara, California; 25 de octubre de 1984), conocida profesionalmente como Katy Perry, es una cantante, compositora y jueza de televisión estadounidense. Después de cantar en una iglesia durante su infancia, siguió una carrera en la música gospel cuando era adolescente. Perry firmó con Red Hill Records y lanzó su álbum de estudio debut Katy Hudson bajo su nombre de nacimiento en 2001, el cual no tuvo éxito comercial.

podcast.title: Misunderstood Work Ethic (2008)
podcast.body: During the 2008 Warped Tour, Katy Perry was voted the "laziest artist" on the bill because she was never seen at any post-show parties. However, Kevin Lyman, the tour founder, clarified that she was actually the hardest working artist that year, waking up at 5 a.m. daily for radio and TV appearances, which prevented her from attending social events. "She was on the Warped Tour in 2008, but she was voted the laziest artist on the bill because she was never at any of the post-show parties."

podcast.title: Lost Album of the Year to The Arcade Fire (2011)
podcast.body: Katy Perry was a nominee for Album of the Year in 2011, but lost to The Arcade Fire's "The Suburbs." "In 2011, the arcade fire were shocked when their album The Suburbs took album of the Year over Eminem, Lady Gaga, Lady Antebellum and Katy Perry."

podcast.title: Feud with Taylor Swift over Backup Dancers (2015)
podcast.body: Katy Perry was involved in a feud with Taylor Swift, which was sparked by "some backup dancers Perry allegedly stole from Swift's tour." This conflict directly inspired Swift's 2015 hit song "Bad Blood," turning a personal and professional disagreement into a public lyrical battle. "a feud Swift had with fellow pop star Katie Perry about some backup dancers Perry allegedly stole from Swift's tour."

podcast.title: Pop Dominance in 2010s
podcast.body: Katy Perry played a role in the ascendance of pop music that led to rock being "swamped" by 2011 or 2012, reflecting the genre's increasing cultural strength throughout the 2010s. "And you can make the argument that it certainly did swamp by not only a rise in pop music, you know, Maroon 5, Justin Bieber, Rihanna, Pink Kitty Perry, Carly Recepcion, Adele, but also by the increasing strength of hip hop and the big beats and bass lines of EDM."

xref.title: Unique Sound in 2009 Musical Landscape
xref.body: In 2009, Mumford & Sons' English folk sound, featuring accordions, banjos, and ukuleles, was considered "a million miles away from what anyone else was offering," providing a stark contrast to the dominant alt-rock bands and pop stars like Beyonce, Katy Perry, and Justin Bieber. "What Mumford was offering the world in 2009 was a million miles away from what anyone else was offering."

xref.body: Shirley Manson, the Scottish singer drafted into the American band Garbage, has had a notable impact on contemporary artists.
